verdicts.reason: A works as a left-to-right banner (product, then logo above the headline and subhead, then CTA) with a clear hierarchy. Its flaws: the product can is jammed against the left edge, the small centred logo floats loosely above the copy, and the decorative circle at top right crowds the CTA's corner. B has a broken reading order: the brand mark is stranded at the far right and a bokeh dot collides with the end of the SOLSTICE wordmark, while the headline and CTA sit tight to the left edge with almost no margin. The product floats in the middle, cut off from the copy, leaving dead space on the right.
